official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Create images, videos, voiceovers and music with your Pixoary creative workspace. Discover supported models and workflows, prepare media requests, retrieve saved creations and reuse supported files from your library. Work with captions, video editing and language swap when the corresponding Studio workflow is available.

Connect your Pixoary account through OAuth and choose the permissions you grant. Media generation uses your existing Pixoary balance. Voice cloning and other voice-rights operations require request-specific permission.

Models, supported media inputs and duration limits vary by workflow. Files attached only to a chat are not automatically available in your Pixoary library. Generation is asynchronous: the plugin reports the saved state and recovers an unconfirmed submission instead of automatically creating a replacement. Some delivery updates require a separate Studio action. Generated media may contain inaccuracies or fail to meet expectations.
